title: Abacus Life Announces Pricing of Public Offering of Common Stock
description: Abacus Life, Inc. announced the pricing of its underwritten public offering of 12.5 million shares of common stock at $8 per share, raising approximately $100 million. The company plans to use the proceeds for operations, including the purchase of life settlement policies, and for general corporate purposes.

title: Abacus Life Completes Acquisition of Carlisle Management Company S.C.A.
description: Abacus Life, a global alternative asset manager, has completed the acquisition of Carlisle Management Company, a leading Luxembourg-based investment fund manager in the life settlement space. The acquisition marks a key milestone in Abacus's strategy to drive long-term growth and diversify its offerings.

title: Abacus Life Completes Acquisition of FCF Advisors
description: Abacus Life, a global alternative asset manager, has completed the acquisition of FCF Advisors, a New York-based asset manager specializing in free cash flow-focused investment strategies. The acquisition expands Abacus Life's offerings within its ABL Wealth division, aligning with its strategy of providing comprehensive, lifespan-based financial solutions.
